findings.summary: The shipped client cannot start or complete a diagnosis, nor archive or restore a company: request() sets Content-Type only when a body is passed (httpClient.ts:80-81), while src/api/diagnosesApi.ts:43 (start), :63 (complete) and src/api/companiesApi.ts:68,72 (archive, restore) post without a body, and server/app.ts:38 requireJsonWrites answers 415 json_required.
findings.failure_scenario: A user opens a company and presses to start a diagnosis: POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses is sent with no Content-Type and the server returns 415 json_required, so the questionnaire never opens. Reproduced with the real httpClient against the real createApp: start 415, complete 415, archive 415, restore 415; the same start with content-type application/json returns 201. Owner: integration (out of this unit's write paths). Recommended fix: httpClient sends Content-Type application/json on every POST/PUT/PATCH, with or without a body. Do NOT relax requireJsonWrites: it is the CSRF guard, since a cross-site no-cors POST carries no Content-Type and no preflight.

findings.summary: startDraft creates a draft for an archived company; the PRD has no rule for it and the UI only hides 'Novo diagnóstico'. Owner decision, not counted against this unit.
findings.failure_scenario: A company is archived, then POST /api/companies/:id/diagnoses still returns a new draft (201). Recommendation if the owner wants it closed: refuse only a new draft with 409 company_archived, keep returning an existing draft, add one test; the frontend then needs a message for that code.
